2024_general.fact: The Elections page lists no 2024 general election files. Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: 'Unofficial Primary Elections Results 03-03-26' is a scanned 20-page Electionware 'Summary Results Report TX Crockett County 260303 Primary 6300 March 3, 2026 UNOFFICIAL RESULTS', county totals by Absentee/Early Voting/Election Day (page 1: 'Election Day Precincts Reporting 4 of 4'; 'Ken Paxton 187 3 95 89'), footer 'Election Summary - 03/03/2026 07:44PM' on every page (read from the page images); Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 16:07:32 GMT. The county Elections page posts no precinct results report for the primary (only county-total unofficial results, reconciliation forms and post-election hand-count audit files), so precinct numbers with election-day votes were not published on election night.

2026_runoff.fact: 'Election Results for Republican and Democratic 5/26/2026' is a scanned 5-page file: two 'Preliminary Election Reconciliation - Unofficial Totals' forms and a 3-page 'Summary Results Report TX Crockett County 260526 Primary Runoff 6300 May 26, 2026 UNOFFICIAL RESULTS', county totals by Absentee/Early Voting/Election Day ('Election Day Precincts Reporting 4 of 4'; 'Ken Paxton 108 4 63 41', 'John Cornyn 79 6 46 27'), footer 'Election Summary - 05/26/2026 07:16PM' (read from the page images); Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 16:26:46 GMT. The county Elections page posts no precinct results report for the runoff (only this file, official reconciliation forms and hand-count audit files), so precinct numbers with election-day votes were not published on election night.
